Main responsibility

Pasindu is responsible for the core FastAPI backend, SQLite database, API endpoints, and integration between frontend/admin/RAG.

Step-by-step tasks
Step 1 — Backend setup

Create FastAPI backend.

Install packages:

pip install fastapi uvicorn sqlalchemy pydantic python-dotenv google-generativeai
pip freeze > requirements.txt
Step 2 — SQLite connection

Create backend/app/database/db.py.

Database should use SQLite:

prajanavigator.db

Expected database URL:

DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./prajanavigator.db"
Step 3 — Create database models

Create these models:

citizen_cases
services
required_documents
offices
officers
ai_responses
crowd_reports
form_templates

id
citizen_name
district
description
detected_service
status
visitguard_score
risk_level
created_at

Step 4 — Create API endpoints

Create these endpoints:

POST   /api/v1/cases
GET    /api/v1/cases
GET    /api/v1/cases/{case_id}
PATCH  /api/v1/cases/{case_id}/status

POST   /api/v1/ai/analyze

GET    /api/v1/services
POST   /api/v1/services

GET    /api/v1/offices
POST   /api/v1/offices

GET    /api/v1/officers
POST   /api/v1/officers

POST   /api/v1/crowd-reports
GET    /api/v1/crowd-reports
PATCH  /api/v1/crowd-reports/{report_id}/verify
Step 5 — Connect AI/RAG part

Create backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/ai.py.

This endpoint should:

Receive citizen request.
Call Savindu’s AI/RAG function.
Save response into ai_responses.
Return final JSON to frontend.

Expected request:

{
  "case_id": 1,
  "description": "I need to renew my NIC",
  "district": "Matara",
  "available_documents": ["Birth Certificate", "Old NIC"]
}

Expected response:

{
  "service_name": "NIC Renewal",
  "visitguard_score": 80,
  "risk_level": "Low",
  "required_documents": [],
  "missing_documents": [],
  "steps": [],
  "office": {},
  "officer": {}
}
Step 6 — Enable CORS

Allow frontend and admin frontend:

http://localhost:5173
http://localhost:5174
Step 7 — Swagger test

Run backend:

uvicorn app.main:app --reload

Open:

http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs

Test all endpoints.

FastAPI backend running
